title: Kwynn
description: Kwynn (Collection of Mods) exclusively for Wynncraft (MMORPG Minecraft Server)
body:
**Kwynn is exclusively for [Wynncraft (MMORPG Minecraft Server)](https://wynncraft.com/), using it outside of the server gives you almost zero benefits.**

**Kwynn enchants your game to run better, smoother and helps you with your journey through the server at the same time, including minimap, market help, player friendly hud and much more. 
(For more details, check mods from modpack.)**



Two unlisted texture packs by Seven aka GotHimInA1Point7.

[Baby Ice Snake](https://forums.wynncraft.com/threads/baby-ice-snakes-for-blizzard-wizards.308275/)

[Baby Meteor](https://forums.wynncraft.com/threads/baby-meteors-pack-so-your-vision-doesnt-get-blocked-while-playing-arcanist.306394/)

Based on other cool modpacks, you can check them out:

[Wynnic Enchantments](https://modrinth.com/modpack/wynnicenchantments)

[Wynncraft 101](https://modrinth.com/modpack/wynncraft)
